Container.Name: DayFront
Container.Overview: DayFront is the open-source CalDAV frontend for calendars and tasks. Connect it to an existing standards-compliant CalDAV server and keep ownership of your data. New installations use individual CalDAV user login; existing legacy single-account installations remain supported.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: calendar caldav tasks todo ics self-hosted
Container.Changes: Add multi-user CalDAV login while preserving single-user mode for existing installations.
Container.Requires: An accessible CalDAV server. New installations only need its URL; DayFront generates and persists a unique login-session secret automatically. Existing legacy installations retain their locally saved shared-account settings. Advanced settings and external calendar subscriptions can optionally be added in /mnt/user/appdata/dayfront/config.yaml.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: DayFront HTTP port. Put this behind HTTPS and authentication when exposed outside a trusted LAN.

Config.Name: CalDAV Server URL
Config.Description: Full HTTP or HTTPS URL of the CalDAV server. This environment value overrides caldav.url in config.yaml.

Config.Name: Authentication Mode
Config.Description: Prompts each user for their own CalDAV credentials. Existing installations without this setting continue using legacy single-user mode.

Config.Name: Session Secret File
Config.Description: File where DayFront generates and retains its encrypted-login session key. Change only when using a custom data mapping.

Config.Name: Session Lifetime
Config.Description: Maximum CalDAV login session lifetime in hours. The default is 720 hours (30 days).

Config.Name: Container Timezone
Config.Description: System timezone used for container logs and runtime behavior, for example UTC or America/Toronto.

Config.Name: Calendar Display Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used to display and interpret calendar values. Use local for each browser's timezone, UTC, or an IANA name such as America/Toronto.

Config.Name: Trust Reverse Proxy
Config.Description: Set true only when DayFront is directly behind a trusted proxy that overwrites forwarded headers.

Config.Name: Persistent Session Data
Config.Description: Stores the automatically generated session secret so users remain signed in across container updates and restarts.

Config.Name: Advanced Configuration Directory
Config.Description: Optional directory containing config.yaml for advanced settings and external calendar subscriptions. Environment fields above take precedence. Mounted read-only because DayFront never modifies it.
